verdict.rationale: Base44 documents a 'sandbox' that external AI coding agents can connect to (base44-docs-3, base44-docs-37). The CLI eject command clones an app into a separate project with its own app ID, which could act as an isolated test copy (base44-docs-22). A testing agent also runs browser-based tests on key app flows (base44-docs-44). However, none of these sources state that the sandbox or tests are isolated from production data, so isolation is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit separation of test/staging data from production data, a documented dev/staging environment model, a statement on which data the testing agent and sandbox operate against, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
